reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm I'd noted it: their dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is now Dock 15, and I'll keep it private like they asked.

I didn't save it to GBrain or to my memory files, because other people can read both and that would break "keep it between us." The only record is the DM thread itself, which Dana can see. I checked GBrain first and found nothing about their dock. That search ran keyword-only, so the brain may still have something under other wording. I took no other action.
